intuition: If a route segment runs out of gas, none of its stations can be the valid start for that segment.

brute_force.approach: Simulate a full circuit starting from each station.

optimal.approach: Track total net gas and the current candidate segment; restart the candidate after any negative running balance.

edge_cases: If total gas is below total cost, no full circuit is possible.
A single station is valid when its gas covers its cost.
